title: What is the average duration of an occupational therapy session?
metaTitle: Duration of Occupational Therapy Sessions | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the typical length of occupational therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network and how our patient-oriented approach tailors the session duration to best benefit your child.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, an occupational therapy session generally varies between 45-60 minutes. However, the precise duration may depend on your child's unique needs and capacity for the therapy. Our therapists meticulously consider your child's level of comfort and adapt the therapy duration accordingly, ensuring each session is fun, effective, and beneficial.
